State-appellant.
2. Ms. Garima Thapa, learned counsel for
the respondent-accused.
SPLA No.166 of 2020
3. State has filed this application u/s
378(3) Cr.P.C. According to learned State
Counsel, trial Court has erred in not
appreciating the testimony of PW1 i.e.
mother of the victim who witnessed the
incident. He further submits that the victim
had supported prosecution case throughout,
and her testimony could not be shaken by
the defence, yet learned trial Court
acquitted the accused-respondent. Thus, he
submits that this is a fit case in which leave
to appeal deserves to be granted.
4. We find some substance in the said
submission. Upon perusal of the record, we
find that this is a fit case which requires re-appreciation of evidence. We accordingly,
grant leave to appeal in this matter. Leave
to appeal application is allowed accordingly.

2
GA No.110 of 2020
5. Admit the appeal.
6. LCR be summoned.
7. Once the LCR is received, Registry to
prepare the paper book and supply the
same to the parties as per rules within four
weeks thereafter.
8. List on 11.01.2024.
